summary.headline: FY26 presales of INR82.5bn and record PAT of about INR11bn-plus (exceptional RMZ gain); net debt near zero; FY27 launches guided above INR150bn.
summary.overview: FY26 presales were about INR82.5bn, down year-on-year from FY25 but up over 30% annually on a FY22-FY26 view, with sales spread steadily across four quarters. Realisation per sq ft crossed INR15,000, up about 20% year-on-year, driven by price escalation and a mix shift to group housing. PAT reached an all-time high, helped by an exceptional item from the RMZ commercial joint venture, while net debt fell to roughly INR2bn. Management guided FY27 to new launches above INR150bn, presales above INR100bn, revenue recognition and collections of about INR50bn each.

segments.name: Residential (Gurugram / Sohna / Manesar)
segments.commentary: FY26 launches of about 6.5 million sq ft, with Cloverdale (about 1.75 million sq ft, Sector 71) and Signature Global Sarvam (about 3.75 million sq ft, Sector 37D) making up about 85%. Launches above INR10,000 crore saw sales above INR4,000 crore.

segments.name: Commercial / JV with RMZ
segments.commentary: 50-50 JV for a mixed-use project in Sector 71 on the Southern Peripheral Road: about 5.5 million sq ft, with 4-4.5 million sq ft of office; expected capital value above INR150bn. Land is fully licensed and activation is planned in FY27.

guidance_outlook: New launches above INR150bn in FY27: about 2 million sq ft Tonino Lamborghini branded residence in Q1, a similar-sized Sector 71 launch in late Q2 or Q3, and a third launch in Q4 tied to the RMZ trade.
Presales above INR100bn in FY27, targeting about 40% sell-through on launch value (about INR60bn from new launches) with the rest from sustaining sales and inventory.
FY27 revenue recognition target of about INR50bn, implying completions of INR60-65bn; collections target above INR50bn.
Completion of about 12 million sq ft in the next 4-5 quarters, taking completed and delivered area to about 30 million sq ft.
Net debt near zero; FY27 land and BD focus on Sohna and larger-format plotted land parcels, with deals hoped to close in H1 FY27.

Expected FY27 capex in the RMZ JV of INR3,500-4,000 crore over 4-4.5 years, funded by JV debt and equity from both partners; Company-level share about INR1,500-2,000 crore per analyst arithmetic. Sanjeev Sharma said JV debt will not enter consolidated debt, but equity contributions will show as investment.
capex_capacity: Total land and development portfolio of about 40 million sq ft (21 million sq ft launched over 8 quarters plus 19 million sq ft land bank), GDV above INR70,000 crore; about 14.5 million sq ft to be executed solely and 5.5 million sq ft via RMZ JV.
About 18 million sq ft completed to date; about 12 million sq ft nearing completion.
Sector 71 holds 90-plus acres; about 18 acres is in the RMZ JV, and the branded residence covers 12-plus acres and about 2 million sq ft.
FY26 business development spend about INR7bn for about 2.5 million sq ft in Sohna; FY26 OCF split roughly one-third to BD, similar amount to debt reduction, and balance to approvals and interest.
Launch pipeline over the next 8-12 quarters to monetise the remaining half of the 40 million sq ft.
demand_pricing: Management cites JLL data showing Delhi NCR housing sales up 30% YoY in Q1 2026, and about INR27,000 crore invested in new Gurugram projects in the first four months of 2026.

Price escalation is attributed to a shortage of livable inventory in Gurugram. Management expects normative price increases but says it will not push prices, and FY26 realisation growth was driven by escalation and premium group housing mix.
No mid-rise launches in FY26, so the mix was tilted to premium product.
Launches are expected to achieve about 40% absorption at launch, which is the internal benchmark; management says it has seen this in FY26.
Management flagged global headwinds that could affect the outlook, with no firm view on their impact.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timing and location of the INR150bn FY27 launch pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1: about 2 million sq ft branded residence (Tonino Lamborghini) in Sector 71. Q2-Q3, around Diwali: a similar-sized Sector 71 launch. Q4: the RMZ residential component, plus a 2 million sq ft Southern Peripheral Road parcel later in the year. A smaller Sohna launch (Daxin inventory) and Phase 2 of Sarvam are also planned.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BD strategy beyond the balance sheet strength?
qa_highlights.answer: Focus on Sohna, where deals are expected to close in H1 FY27, and on larger-format plotted/mixed land parcels for collaborations, following the City of Colours model in Manesar.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY26 collection guidance of INR5,000 crore lower than the INR6,000 crore start-of-year guidance, and why is FY27 not higher?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it prefers conservative targets; collections and completions are linked, and the company set figures it sees as achievable. Actual FY26 collections were about INR4,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What is the inventory value on hand?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said legacy ongoing-project inventory is about INR7bn, and recently launched inventory is about INR70-80bn, so total inventory is about INR80-85bn.

qa_highlights.question: How will the FY27 INR15,000 crore launches be sold, and how much of the guidance comes from sustenance sales?
qa_highlights.answer: Target is 40% of launch value (about INR6,000 crore) from new launches, with the rest (about INR4,000 crore) from sustenance sales of existing inventory. The analyst's summary of this split was accepted by management.

qa_highlights.question: What is the RMZ JV capex and accounting treatment?
qa_highlights.answer: It is a 50-50 JV with equal control. Capex of INR3,500-4,000 crore is expected over 4-4.5 years, funded by JV-level construction debt and equity from both partners. Per Sanjeev Sharma, JV debt stays off the consolidated balance sheet, and equity infusions appear as investment in the JV.

qa_highlights.question: Is Gurugram demand still healthy, and will ticket sizes around INR4 crore per unit persist?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there were very few delivered units in Gurugram from 2014-22 and that post-2022 launches have not yet completed, so prices keep rising. It expects about 40%-plus absorption at launch, and said FY27 targets are achievable if the global backdrop stabilises.

risks_watch: Presales fell YoY in FY26; FY27 presales above INR100bn depend on about INR60bn from launches and the timing of the three planned launches in the year.
Completion slippage: FY26 completions were below plan due to monsoon and NGT restrictions, and about 12 million sq ft must finish in 4-5 quarters.
Collections (INR5,000 crore target) were well below the INR6,000 crore FY26 target; FY27 collection of above INR50bn needs execution.
Global macro headwinds were flagged without quantification.
RMZ JV: execution, JV-level debt and equity needs of about INR3,500-4,000 crore, and exceptional-item accounting for the FY26 PAT.
Sohna and plotted BD deals expected in H1 FY27 are not yet closed; FY26 BD was lower than prior years.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the medium-term pipeline and balance sheet, with a deliberately conservative tone on near-term targets. Management was open on the FY26 presales dip and the collections shortfall, and gave specific launch-timing and capex numbers, while giving no firm macro view.
key_quotes: So effectively, we've been formally believing that supply creation leads to demand creation and vice versa.
It's just 2 billion, could have been positive or minus 2, but by and large, this is almost down to a 0 level net debt position.
We are not going to push that sale prices up.
We don't want to kind of get sound very aggressive with regard to these plans.

adds.what: About 2 million sq ft Tonino Lamborghini branded residence launch in Q1 FY27 (launch, not productive capacity)
Completion of about 12 million sq ft of nearing-completion stock over next 4-5 quarters
RMZ 50-50 JV mixed-use project in Sector 71, about 5.5 million sq ft (4-4.5 million sq ft office), capex INR3,500-4,000 crore over 4-4.5 years

growth.why: FY27 guided to new launches above INR150bn, presales above INR100bn and revenue recognition of INR50bn (vs FY26 presales of INR82.5bn, down YoY), backed by a launch cadence of about 2m sq ft per quarter and 12m sq ft of near-complete stock, though no quantified FY26 revenue growth is given and global headwinds are unquantified.
